skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of innovation and creativity, the role of individuals and relationships in innovation, and the ability to analyze and evaluate innovation activities at micro and macro levels.
Develop and foster an innovative organizational culture, and use methods to enhance creativity and innovation within organizations.
Manage risks in the innovation process and recognize, evaluate risks at the organizational level.
Understand intellectual property rights, infringement, and implement solutions to enforce intellectual property rights.
Demonstrate effective presentation, teamwork, and group management skills.
Analyze and evaluate innovation activities at micro and macro levels, and use methods to enhance creativity and innovation within organizations.
Perform independent tasks in innovation management, continuously improve skills, and adapt to changes.
Maintain professional ethics and social responsibility.
